'''Taba''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] whose leaves were used in cooking. The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] used taba leaves to make the [[gartro egg salad]] that he used in the [[gartro egg salad sandwich]] he sold at his [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />   

==Behind the scenes==
Taba leaves were set to appear the ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''<ref name="Holiday Special">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref> released in [[1978]];<ref name="Boba Fett: Mystery Man">{{GalaxyCite|1|Boba Fett: Mystery Man in Not-So-Shining Armor}}</ref> however, the appearance was ultimately cut from the special.<ref name="Holiday Special" /> In the script, [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] chef [[Gormaanda/Legends|Gormaanda]] added taba leaves to the [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] [[Bantha Surprise]] in order to enhance the flavor and add [[Color/Legends|color]] for [[Eye/Legends|eye]] appeal. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]][[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]], who was following along with Gormaanda's recipe added very large leaves to her version. The script also indicated that the real world [[Wikipedia:Bay leaf|bay leaves]] were going to be used to represent taba leaves.<ref name="Script">The forth draft of the ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'' script was posted to a fansite {{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarsholidayspecial.com/swhs-old/text/script.htm|text=The Fourth Draft Script - 09/13/78|archivedate=20251119085058}}</ref> Taba leaves were later mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
